title: 09 / Membrane
sub: A shaman strikes a great drum three times, each harder than the last, and then once more. Time all but stops as the beater lands: rings crawl across the hide, our universe's membrane ripples with it, and the hide thins to a veil on a vision inside the drum, a corridor of golden gateways running to a source of light. Nothing is struck again; she stands and watches as it all deepens into the dark. A seamless 50-second loop in WebGPU, the drum's sound simulated from its own physics.

title: 04 / Gyre
sub: Forty glazed hoops, each one flipping over twice a loop, starting from the outside. A seamless 16-second loop, sphere-traced in WebGPU.
